s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal syndrome with vomiting and abdominal pain in the context of fasting and marked weight loss
salient_findings: Compression of the third portion of the duodenum
key_facts: Progressive inability to tolerate oral intake
Abdominal ultrasonography showed marked gastric distension
Plain radiographs showed marked gastric distension
Nasogastric tube was placed for decompression
Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen revealed compression of the third portion of the duodenum
No intrinsic luminal lesions found on endoscopy

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal syndrome with vomiting and abdominal pain in the context of fasting and marked weight loss
salient_findings: Compression of the third portion of the duodenum
key_facts: Progressive inability to tolerate oral intake
Abdominal ultrasonography showed marked gastric distension
Plain radiographs showed marked gastric distension
Nasogastric tube was placed for decompression

No intrinsic luminal lesions found on endoscopy

differentials: Intra-abdominal desmoplastic small round cell tumor
Systemic Lupus Erythematosus with gastrointestinal manifestations
Acquired Duodenal Stenosis due to Peptic Ulcer Disease
Intestinal Lymphoma with secondary duodenal involvement
Fibromuscular Dysplasia of the Superior Mesenteric Artery

shortlist.label: Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Compression of the third portion of the duodenum between the superior mesenteric artery and the aorta at an acute angle

shortlist.label: Gastroparesis
shortlist.why_kept: Intractable vomiting, postprandial upper abdominal pain, and bloating in the context of marked weight loss and fasting

shortlist.label: Small Bowel Obstruction
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive inability to tolerate oral intake and abdominal distension

shortlist.label: Duodenal Stenosis
shortlist.why_kept: Compression of the third portion of the duodenum and abdominal pain

raw.rationale: The contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen revealed compression of the third portion of the duodenum between the superior mesenteric artery and the aorta at an acute angle, which is a hallmark of Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome.

rejected.label: Gastroparesis
rejected.why: Normal upper gastrointestinal endoscopy and no intrinsic luminal lesions found

rejected.label: Gastric Outlet Obstruction
rejected.why: No intrinsic luminal lesions found on endoscopy

rejected.label: Small Bowel Obstruction
rejected.why: Compression of the third portion of the duodenum is more specific to Superior Mesenteric Artery Syndrome

rejected.label: Duodenal Stenosis
rejected.why: No intrinsic luminal lesions found on endoscopy, suggesting an extrinsic cause like compression
